subject: Eversource Transmission Line Project Update
overview: City officials and Eversource representatives presented an updated construction timeline and repaving schedule for the redundant electric transmission line project. Staff fielded resident feedback regarding construction delays, night work, road conditions, and neighborhood impacts.

items.title: Introduction and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn introduced city staff and outlined the meeting's goal to provide transparent updates and collect public input on the Eversource transmission project schedule.

items.title: Eversource Project Overview and Construction Schedule
items.summary: City Engineer Owen Wartella detailed the location-by-location timeline for remaining trenching, pipe proofing, cable pulling, splicing, and final milling and paving extending into 2023.

items.title: Public Q&A on Construction Impacts and Timelines
items.summary: City staff and an Eversource representative addressed resident concerns regarding night work noise, severe pavement deterioration along Winthrop Street, equipment staging, and project delays.

items.title: Upcoming Traffic Commission Meeting and Closing
items.summary: Director of Traffic and Transportation Todd Blake announced a June 14 Traffic Commission meeting to present pavement marking plans for Winthrop Street before the meeting concluded.
